intent: Pre-release from pinned beta branch after Python 3.13/3.14, translations, frontend, Hassfest, and HACS checks; never update main or stable latest
note: Room Environment owns capability-derived controller limits; controllers prefer selected room feedback over device-native measurements
changes: Move temperature, humidity and percentage-fan min/max controls from physical-device controllers to the Room Environment device
Derive each room limit's editable range from the intersection of the available selected physical devices that support that capability
Apply one room limit set to every compatible managed controller while still respecting each device's stricter native bounds
Conservatively migrate beta17 per-device limits to room defaults and remove only the obsolete beta17 per-device limit registry entities
Use explicitly selected room temperature/humidity/air-quality sensors as the controller feedback source; aggregate multiple selected room sensors
Do not let a climate device's own temperature/humidity reading override explicitly selected room measurements
Keep per-device Quiet when in room/sleeping and Always/Occupied/Absent policies unchanged
Retain availability-first calculations, command ownership, dwell/interlock protections, rooms-first setup and stable v0.5.1
